steps: Read package.json, tell me the exact version ranges of jsonwebtoken and password-validator as written in the file, then change jsonwebtoken to ^9.0.3 with an edit.
expected: Ordinary code such as `"jsonwebtoken": "^9.0.2"` reaches the model byte-exact in read/shell tool results; only credential-shaped values are masked (issue #5546; fixed in 0.9.11 by commit 2776c214 'redact_model_bound_secrets').
defect: Model-bound tool results are run through the broad key-based scrubber, so values next to keys containing token/password (dependency versions) are replaced with `[redacted]`, which breaks exact-match edits and read-back.

fault location.explanation: Applies the sanitizer to every model-bound tool-result content block before provider projection.
Calls the broad persistence::redact_secrets policy after exact-value secret masking; this is the call site changed by the upstream fix.
Matches sensitive key substrings without classifying the value, then replaces the remainder. The token/password hints are declared at lines 234-247.

Root cause: At recorded revision 369868d23e593acd71da51db30058b512175e08d (native ACP version 0.9.10), prepare_model_bound_request rewrites every ContentBlock::ToolResult using redact_model_bound_text. After replacing configured secret values, that helper calls persistence::redact_secrets, a broad key-based log scrubber. redact_keyed_assignment tests whether the key contains a sensitive substring (including token/password) and replaces the whole nonempty value without checking credential shape. Thus jsonwebtoken and password-validator match even when their values are ordinary dependency versions; the same reconstruction also drops a trailing comma. Native ACP output for call_815783ad7600491f97ae1c55 contains ^9.0.2 and ^5.3.0, while the model-bound result with that exact ID contains [redacted]. Upstream fix 2776c214efd52528e0432ecdbbed22df4921d53c changes this helper to redact_model_bound_secrets and adds a byte-exact ordinary-code regression test. This review locates the model-bound visibility defect; the recorded final edit succeeds through a workaround. See analysis/root-cause-20261028/README.md and evidence.json for provenance and trajectory limitations.
